notable_absence.finding: The page shows OpenTelemetryRequestSpan.wrap()/parentSpan() creating and passing spans into SDK calls, but never states whether an application-created parent span, or a span the SDK creates internally, needs to be explicitly ended/closed by the caller - unlike the already-promoted requiresExplicitClose relation elsewhere in the registry (eventing:n1ql-result-iterator), span lifecycle management is left unaddressed on this page.

cross_product_finding: Like observability-metrics.md, this page's OpenTelemetry path hands off entirely to third-party tracing backends named explicitly in the text (Jaeger, Zipkin, opentelemetry-collector) rather than to any Couchbase-branded surface, and OpenTracing is explicitly framed as a sunset legacy protocol rather than a currently-maintained integration target.
